title: Thank You | Vertical Wealth
description: Thanks for reaching out to Vertical Wealth. Here's what to expect on your discovery call with Brian, and a few things to explore while you wait.

blocks.headline: You're all set
blocks.body: Thanks for reaching out. If you booked a discovery call, it's on Brian's calendar. If you signed up for Weekly Lessons, watch your inbox for your first lesson.

blocks.heading: What to expect on your discovery call
blocks.body: Need to change the time? Call (317) 794-2148 or email info@verticalwealth.life.
items: 15 minutes with Brian: a relaxed, no-pressure conversation.
Your story: tell us about your family, your goals and your biggest questions.
Nothing to prepare: no statements or paperwork needed.
A clear next step: if it feels like a good fit for both of us, we'll set up a deep dive, 1 to 2 hours to look at the full picture.

items.title: Weekly Lessons
items.body: One short email each week with scripture, a personal insight from Brian and one step to take. Free, and you can unsubscribe any time.

items.title: Our approach
items.body: The biblical principles that shape how we plan, invest and give.
